mapper.select:
SELECT AA.*, AP.`PROMPT_TITLE` AS promptTitle FROM `AI_AGENT` AA LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENV_CODE, PROMPT_KEY, MAX(VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM `AI_PROMPT` WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ENV_CODE, PROMPT_KEY ) LATEST_P ON LATEST_P.ENV_CODE = AA.ENV_CODE AND LATEST_P.PROMPT_KEY = AA.PROMPT_KEY LEFT JOIN `AI_PROMPT` AP ON AP.PROMPT_KEY = AA.PROMPT_KEY AND AP.ENV_CODE = AA.ENV_CODE AND AP.VERSION = LATEST_P.MAX_VERSION AND (AP.DELETED = 0 OR AP.DELETED IS NULL) WHERE (AA.DELETED = 0 OR AA.DELETED IS NULL)
AND AA.AGENT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.name}, '%')
AND AA.STATUS = #{req.status}
ORDER BY AA.CREATE_TIME DESC
